Pets on Aurelia Skyways: Companion Animal Travel Desk

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. This guide helps you move from planning to check-in with less stress for you and your pet.

Before travel, confirm documentation and crate suitability. The desk team focuses on calm, humane handling, and your passenger coordinator will walk you through the required steps so you are not guessing at the gate. If you have questions, ask early; clear guidance is part of the service.

Crate readiness matters. Use a secure, well-ventilated carrier that fits the space your route requires. Make sure your pet can sit, stand, and turn comfortably, and keep the crate closed during processing. For some animals, weight and age rules apply, and following them keeps everything moving smoothly.

Aurelia Skyways sets the heaviest allowed weight for a rabbit and crate together at 18 kg. For age eligibility, a bird can travel starting at 15 weeks.

If you are coordinating for Finn, or traveling with advice from Aya Johnson or Talia Moretti, share details with the desk staff so they can align the plan with your situation. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
